title.zh: ESMA gives crypto firms 3 months to exit non-compliant stablecoins
title.en: ESMA gives crypto firms 3 months to exit non-compliant stablecoins

current_state.zh: ESMA told EU regulators to ensure MiCA-licensed crypto firms halt all services involving non-compliant stablecoins, setting a hard deadline of Jan. 8, 2027 to wind down existing exposures.
